usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-interest` command and listed it in `help` directly after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes all 8 tests, including two acceptance tests I added. The work, the decision record and the report are committed.
Open question: nonprofits are charged interest. Their late-fee exemption has no decision record, and DEC-B14 says interest applies to every invoice that owes it. Also, `show` is unchanged and doesn't print interest, so its outstanding figure can look too high with no visible reason.

OUTCOME: completed
